mapper.sql: cdc_run_id, migration_run_id, topic_prefix, connector_name, status, snapshot_completed, snapshot_completed_at, initial_load_at, last_error, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdc_run (migration_run_id, topic_prefix, connector_name, status) VALUES (#{migrationRunId}, #{topicPrefix}, #{connectorName}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_run SET topic_prefix = 'legacy_r' || cdc_run_id, connector_name = 'cdc-legacy-r' || cdc_run_id, updated_at = now() WHERE cdc_run_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cdc_run ORDER BY cdc_run_id DESC
SELECT FROM cdc_run WHERE status IN ('SNAPSHOTTING', 'LOADING', 'STREAMING') ORDER BY cdc_run_id
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_run SET status = #{status}, snapshot_completed = #{snapshotCompleted}, snapshot_completed_at = #{snapshotCompletedAt}, initial_load_at = #{initialLoadAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = now() WHERE cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdc_snapshot_table (cdc_run_id, table_name, expected_rows, scan_completed) VALUES (#{cdcRunId}, #{tableName}, #{expectedRows}, true) ON CONFLICT (cdc_run_id, table_name) DO UPDATE SET expected_rows = EXCLUDED.expected_rows, scan_completed = true
mapper.select: SELECT x.table_name, s.expected_rows, coalesce(s.scan_completed, false) AS scan_completed, (SELECT count(*) FROM cdc_event e WHERE e.cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId} AND e.snapshot AND e.table_name = x.table_name) AS staged_rows FROM unnest(CAST(ARRAY[#{t}] AS VARCHAR[])) AS x(table_name) LEFT JOIN cdc_snapshot_table s ON s.cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId} AND s.table_name = x.table_name

INSERT INTO cdc_event (cdc_run_id, event_key, topic, kafka_partition, kafka_offset, table_name, source_key, op, snapshot, source_lsn, payload, status) VALUES (#{cdcRunId}, #{eventKey}, #{topic}, #{kafkaPartition}, #{kafkaOffset}, #{tableName}, #{sourceKey}, #{op}, #{snapshot}, #{sourceLsn}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), #{status}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_cdc_event DO NOTHING RETURNING event_id
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_event SET duplicate_count = duplicate_count + 1 WHERE cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId} AND event_key = #{eventKey}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cdc_event WHERE cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND event_id < #{eventId})
SELECT event_id, cdc_run_id, table_name, op, CAST(payload AS TEXT) AS payload, attempts FROM cdc_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_event SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{message}, attempts = attempts + 1, applied_at = CASE WHEN CAST(#{status} AS VARCHAR) = 'APPLIED' THEN now() ELSE applied_at END WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT status, count(*) AS cnt FROM cdc_event WHERE cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId} GROUP BY status
SELECT coalesce(sum(duplicate_count), 0) FROM cdc_event WHERE cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_event SET attempts = 0 WHERE cdc_run_id = #{cdcRunId} AND status = 'WAITING'
